title: EnerMod Africa: the African Energy Modelling Observatory

creators.name: Plakoo, Kodjovi Aymard
creators.affiliation: MINES Paris-PSL (CMA, The Transition Institute 1.5), for AISESA Cluster 1

description: An open observatory of energy modelling studies applied to African countries, the tools they use and the institutions that lead them. It started from a PRISMA 2020 systematic review (1,053 studies, 101 tools, 54 countries) and is kept up to date through community contributions, an automated literature search and curator review. Code GPL-3.0; data exports CC BY 4.0. Site: https://enermod.africa
